name: Hallowed Soldier
description: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.

abilities.name: Minion (13)
abilities.description: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Divine Flight
abilities.description: While the Soldier is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.
